subscription_cashback_faq.faq_answer: An offer is automatically applied when you create a subscription for a product. If you’re eligible, you’ll see it on the product page.
subscription_cashback_faq.faq_question: How does a cashback offer work?

subscription_cashback_faq.faq_question: How & when will I receive cashback?

subscription_cashback_faq.faq_answer: You can view all your cashback details in your bbWallet transactions by tapping on “View all cashback”.
subscription_cashback_faq.faq_question: Where can I see my cashback history?

subscription_cashback_faq.faq_answer: Yes. Cashback is calculated on the actual quantities delivered, based on the applicable limits of an offer. If you reduce the quantity, the cashback will reduce accordingly.
subscription_cashback_faq.faq_question: Will my cashback change if I update the quantity?

subscription_cashback_faq.faq_answer: You earn cashback only for successful deliveries. If your deliveries are skipped or paused, your cashback cycle simply pauses and resumes when deliveries start again.
subscription_cashback_faq.faq_question: What happens if a delivery is skipped or paused?

subscription_cashback_faq.faq_answer: If you return a product, the cashback earned for it will be deducted from your bbWallet. The rest of your cashback cycle will continue as is.
subscription_cashback_faq.faq_question: What happens if I return a product after cashback is credited?

subscription_cashback_faq.faq_answer: No. Cashback is non-transferable. It cannot be moved out of your bbWallet to any other account.
